name: Lido
description: Liquid staking for Ethereum and Polygon. Daily staking rewards, no lock ups.

methodology.UserFees: Lido takes no fees from users.
methodology.Fees: Staking rewards earned by all staked ETH
methodology.Revenue: Lido takes a 10% fee on staking rewards; Revenue is only the DAO-treasury portion of that fee (net of the node-operator share, which is a cost of production booked as SupplySideRevenue). From Lido V2 (2023-05-15) the treasury/operator split is the validator-share-weighted aggregate read live from the StakingRouter; before V2 the split was a fixed 5%/5%, so half the fee is treasury.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: DAO-treasury portion of the 10% fee (same as Revenue); excludes the node-operator share.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Staking rewards earned by stETH holders plus the node-operator share of the 10% fee (paid to operators for running validators).
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Tracks LIDO bought back by the DAO as part of the LDO Accumulation Program

hallmarks: Start of incentives for curve pool

Fees.Staking Rewards: ETH rewards from running Beacon chain validators.
Fees.MEV Rewards: ETH rewards from MEV tips on ETH execution layer paid by block builders.

Revenue.Staking Rewards: DAO treasury share of staking rewards. From Lido V2 (2023-05-15) the ratio is read live from StakingRouter.getStakingFeeAggregateDistributionE4Precision() — treasuryFee / (modulesFee + treasuryFee); before V2 it defaults to the fixed 5%/5% split (treasury share 0.5).
Revenue.MEV Rewards: DAO treasury share of MEV rewards.

ProtocolRevenue.Staking Rewards: DAO treasury share of staking rewards.
ProtocolRevenue.MEV Rewards: DAO treasury share of MEV rewards.

SupplySideRevenue.Staking rewards to ETH stakers: Share of ETH rewards from running Beacon chain validators to stakers.
SupplySideRevenue.MEV rewards to ETH stakers: Share of ETH rewards from MEV tips on ETH execution layer paid by block builders to stakers.
SupplySideRevenue.Staking rewards to node operators: Share of ETH rewards from running Beacon chain validators to node operators.
SupplySideRevenue.MEV rewards to node operators: Share of ETH rewards from MEV tips on ETH execution layer paid by block builders to node operators.

HoldersRevenue.LDO Accumulation Program: Tracks LIDO bought back by the DAO.
